info.title: Work Graph API
info.description: The pre-stable canonical REST contract for Work Graph coordination.

servers.description: Local or production Work Graph service origin

tags.name: work-items
tags.description: Work-item creation, listing, readiness, and terminal transitions.

tags.name: attention
tags.description: Requests for human decisions or review.

get.description: Returns unresolved requests by default in stable request-ID order. Filters can include resolved requests or select blocking and non-blocking work.

200.description: Attention requests in stable request-ID order

409.description: Request conflicts with current Work Graph state

post.description: Records the decision or review needed. A blocking request atomically ends the current lease and removes the work item from the claimable queue.

schema.description: Client-generated mutation ID. Reusing it with the same request replays the committed effect. Reusing it for different input returns a conflict.

post.description: Records one resolution and returns the work item's newly derived stage. The item becomes ready only when no other readiness blocker remains.

post.summary: Claim a specified or first eligible work item
post.description: Creates a fenced lease for the requested item, or for the first eligible item in stable fallback order when workItemId is absent.

201.description: Lease created and work item claimed

409.description: Request conflicts with current Work Graph state

post.summary: Renew the current lease at its fenced epoch
post.description: Extends a live lease only when its ID and epoch still identify the current worker claim.

409.description: Request conflicts with current Work Graph state

get.summary: List work items with their derived stage
get.description: Returns one bounded page in stable work-item ID order. The optional stage filter uses the current derived projection. Pass nextCursor to continue after the last observed ID without offset drift during lease transitions.

200.description: Work items in stable work-item ID order

409.description: Request conflicts with current Work Graph state

post.description: Creates an open work item from its identity and title, with an optional parent. Lifecycle and operational stage are not accepted because the service derives them from graph state.

409.description: Request conflicts with current Work Graph state

get.summary: Read a work item with its derived stage
get.description: Returns stored lifecycle data together with the current derived operational stage and lease.

409.description: Request conflicts with current Work Graph state

post.summary: Cancel claimed work at its fenced lease epoch
post.description: Ends the current lease and changes the named work item's stored lifecycle to cancelled.

201.description: Work item cancelled and lease ended

409.description: Request conflicts with current Work Graph state

post.summary: Decompose claimed work into ranked children
post.description: Creates ranked children and dependency edges, ends the fenced parent lease with a decomposed outcome, and can claim one ready child for the same worker in one transaction. Children retain the parent link used to resolve inherited context.

post.description: Records a short or long note only when the supplied lease ID and epoch still own the named work item.
